54







                           NEW YORK STATE SENATE











                          THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD



















                             ALBANY, NEW YORK



                             January 13, 2003



                                 3:08 p.m.











                              REGULAR SESSION















            LT. GOVERNOR MARY O. DONOHUE, President



            STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary



































                                                        55







                           P R O C E E D I N G S



                            THE PRESIDENT:    The Senate will



                 please come to order.



                            I ask everyone present to please



                 rise and repeat with me the Pledge of



                 Allegiance.



                            (Whereupon, the assemblage recited



                 the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)



                            THE PRESIDENT:    In the absence of



                 clergy, may we all bow our heads in a moment



                 of silence, please.



                            (Whereupon, the assemblage



                 respected a moment of silence.)



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Reading of the



                 Journal.



                            THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,



                 Saturday, January 11, the Senate met pursuant



                 to adjournment.  The Journal of Friday,



                 January 10, was read and approved.  On motion,



                 Senate adjourned.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    Without



                 objection, the Journal stands approved as



                 read.



                            Presentation of petitions.



                            Messages from the Assembly.











                                                        56







                            Messages from the Governor.



                            Reports of standing committees.



                            Reports of select committees.



                            Communications and reports from



                 state officers.



                            Motions and resolutions.



                            Senator Bruno.



                            SENATOR BRUNO:    Madam President,



                 I'd like to hand up temporary assignments for



                 the Majority committees, so that we can go



                 forward with the meetings, and ask that they



                 be filed in the Journal.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    To be filed in



                 the Journal.



                            Senator Bruno again.



                            SENATOR BRUNO:    And, Madam



                 President, in consultation with Senator



                 Paterson, we're handing up the Minority



                 assignments for temporary assignments to the



                 committees.  I ask that they also be filed in



                 the Journal.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    The notice will



                 be filed in the Journal, Senator.



                            Senator Bruno.



                            SENATOR BRUNO:    And I would ask











                                                        57







                 that there be an immediate meeting of the



                 Finance Committee in the Majority Conference



                 Room.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    There will be an



                 immediate meeting of the Finance Committee in



                 the Majority Conference Room.



                            SENATOR BRUNO:    And the Senate



                 will stand at ease for just a few moments



                 while the committee is meeting.



                            THE PRESIDENT:    The Senate stands



                 at ease.



                            (Whereupon, the Senate stood at



                 ease at 3:10 p.m.)



                            (Whereupon, the Senate reconvened



                 at 3:21 p.m.)



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Senator Alesi.



                            SENATOR ALESI:    There will be an



                 immediate meeting of the Codes Committee in



                 the Senate Majority Conference Room.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Thank you.  There will be an immediate meeting



                 of the Codes Committee in the Senate Majority



                 Conference Room.



                            SENATOR ALESI:    And the Senate











                                                        58







                 will stand at ease.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Before we do that, Senator Meier.



                            SENATOR MEIER:    Thank you, Mr.



                 President.  On behalf of Senator Volker, I



                 move that Senate Bill 197 be discharged from



                 committee and be recommitted with instructions



                 to strike the enacting clause.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:    So



                 ordered.



                            The Senate will stand at ease.



                            (Whereupon, the Senate stood at



                 ease at 3:22 p.m.)



                            (Whereupon, the Senate reconvened



                 at 3:41 p.m.)



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Senator Kuhl.



                            SENATOR KUHL:    Yes, Mr.



                 President.  We'd like to announce an immediate



                 meeting of the Local Governments Committee in



                 the Majority Conference Room, Room 332.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Thank you.  There will be an immediate meeting



                 of the Local Governments Committee in the



                 Majority Conference Room.











                                                        59







                            SENATOR KUHL:    Thank you.  The



                 Senate will continue to stand at ease.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:    The



                 Senate will stand at ease.



                            (Whereupon, the Senate stood at



                 ease at 3:42 p.m.)



                            (Whereupon, the Senate reconvened



                 at 3:55 p.m.)



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Senator Skelos.



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    If we could



                 return to reports of standing committees, I



                 believe there are several reports at the desk.



                 I ask that they be read at this time.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Reports of standing committees.



                            The Secretary will read.



                            THE SECRETARY:    Senator Johnson,



                 from the Committee on Finance, reports the



                 following bills:



                            Senate Print Number 1, by Senator



                 Bruno, Concurrent Resolution of the Senate and



                 Assembly proposing amendments to Article 7 of



                 the Constitution;











                                                        60







                            And Senate Print Number 2, by



                 Senator Bruno, an act to amend the State



                 Finance Law.



                            Senator Volker, from the Committee



                 on Codes, reports:



                            Senate Print 37, by Senator



                 Padavan, an act to amend the Penal Law;



                            46, by Senator Alesi, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            59, by Senator Alesi, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            89, by Senator Maltese, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            99, by Senator Velella, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            180, by Senator Hoffmann, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            181, by Senator Hoffmann, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            215, by Senator Saland, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            236, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Criminal Procedure Law;



                            237, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Criminal Procedure Law;











                                                        61







                            240, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            241, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            242, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Penal Law;



                            243, by Senator Volker, an act to



                 amend the Criminal Procedure Law;



                            246, by Senator Skelos, an act to



                 amend the Correction Law;



                            And Senate Print 277, by Senator



                 Skelos, an act to amend the Penal Law.



                            Senator Little, from the Committee



                 on Local Government, reports:



                            Senate Print 18, by Senator



                 Padavan, an act to amend the General Municipal



                 Law;



                            50, by Senator Padavan, an act to



                 amend the County Law and others;



                            136, by Senator Maltese, an act to



                 amend the Municipal Home Rule Law;



                            203, by Senator Kuhl, an act to



                 authorize;



                            259, by Senator Skelos, an act



                 authorizing the assessor of the County of











                                                        62







                 Nassau;



                            261, by Senator Skelos, an act to



                 authorize the assessor of the County of



                 Nassau;



                            And Senate Print 328, by Senator



                 DeFrancisco, an act to amend the Town Law.



                            All bills reported direct to third



                 reading.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Without objection, all bills reported to third



                 reading.



                            Senator Skelos.



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President,



                 on behalf of Senator Bruno, I hand up the



                 following committee chair assignments and ask



                 that they be filed in the Journal.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Notice will be filed in the Journal.



                            Senator Skelos.



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President,



                 in consultation with Senator Paterson, Senator



                 Bruno hands up the following Minority ranking



                 member appointments and asks that it be filed



                 in the Journal.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:











                                                        63







                 Notice will be filed in the Journal.



                            Senator Skelos.



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    On behalf of



                 Senator Bruno, at this time I'd like to hand



                 up a notice of his intent to amend the Senate



                 Rules and ask that it be filed in the Journal.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:



                 Notice will be filed in the Journal.



                            Senator Skelos.



                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President,



                 there being no further business, I move we



                 adjourn until Tuesday, January 14th, at



                 12:30 p.m.



                            ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:    On



                 motion, the Senate stands adjourned until



                 Tuesday, January 14th, at 12:30.



                            (Whereupon, at 3:59 p.m., the



                 Senate adjourned.)
